description: Docker or Podman on this machine: detect the runtime, build, tag, push, run, inspect, and clean up images and containers. Nothing here touches IBM Cloud except push and login. To build, push, and deploy in one step, use proc_build_push_deploy instead. Call get_schema with name local_container for every action's fields.

action.description: detect: Report whether Docker or Podman is installed. | build: Build an image from a Dockerfile. Needs dockerfile_path, image_name, context_path. | images: List local images. | inspect: Show architecture, ports, entrypoint, and env of one image. Needs image_name. | tag: Give an image a new name, e.g. its full ICR path. Needs source_image, target_image. | push: Push an image. For ICR, image_name is the full path like us.icr.io/<namespace>/<app>:<tag>; log in first. Needs image_name. | login: Log in to a registry. For ICR only registry is needed; the server uses its IBM Cloud key. Needs registry. | run: Run an image locally to test it. Needs image_name. | containers: List running containers, or all with all=true. | logs: Show logs of a local container. Needs container_id. | stop: Stop a local container; remove=true also deletes it. Needs container_id. | remove_image: Delete a local image. Needs image_name. | prune: Delete dangling images, or all unused images with all=true.

all.description: Include stopped containers (default: false — running only)

force.description: Force removal even if the image is used by a stopped container (default: false)

password.description: Password or API key. For ICR leave blank to use IBMCLOUD_API_KEY env var.

remove.description: Remove the container after stopping (default: false)

tail.description: Number of trailing log lines to return (default: 200)

username.description: Username — use "iamapikey" for ICR with an IBM Cloud API key

name: local_container
